finalState: Clock: 13:15, Tuesday, 13 October 2026. Play stops here.

fields.hotWashTransition: Thank you, everyone. Please put down your phones and close your inboxes. We'll take ten minutes and then start the hot wash. Bring your clock board times, the classification record for LI-2026-0142 and the written basis for each decision you signed.
fields.hotWashMethod: Timeline walk-back followed by 3-Up, 3-Down. First, rebuild the clock board from 09:02 discovery to 13:15. Then name three things that went well and three things that broke.
hotWashQuestions: When did Lena's medical evaluation become the first priority? Who held the line when she wanted to finish her run first?
Which deadline governed the sponsor notice: the HSU 7-day default or the 72-hour award term? When did the clock board catch up, and who acted on it?

How did the IBC chair classify the event? Was the possible face splash and skin break treated as an exposure for the NIH report? How did the program officer's informal 11:36 opinion and the 'log it internally' email affect that decision?
How did we keep the freezer mismatch on four from becoming a select agent report? What written record closed it, and when did the postdoc get it?
How did we answer the 'lab leak' claim and the Herald's deadlines without naming the student or the lab? Was the HSUAlert offer the right call either way?
fields.facilitatorNote: Before the break, collect the clock board printouts, the I-12 decision version (A or B) the players signed, the front-desk clearance sheet, the holding statement and the IBC chair's classification record. Ask the BSO to list items for the 30-day no-blame review and the IBC summary at its next meeting, and enter the corrective actions (overdue rotor inspection, bounced vendor reminder address, paper-only freezer transfers, badge tailgating) for tracking.
